block_05_direct_answer.title: Direct answer
block_05_direct_answer.body_html: Freehold ownership can provide strong property rights, but safety still depends on the specific transaction. For apartment buyers, verify title or registration, property status, developer or seller authority, contractual terms and any restrictions attached to the asset. Freehold status does not remove the need for legal, project and payment checks.
